text:
Priya: Heads up — courier dropped off an e-bike (folding) and a big potted Ficus for 'Elias Kim' (visiting with @Zoe). Need storage plan and badge/escort?
Frontdesk Bot: Package logged as PRCL-6001. Visitor checked in: Elias Kim. Temporary badge printed and waiting at desk.
Noah: E-bike looks heavy; might leak chain oil. Anyone have cardboard or a tarp to protect the floor? Is there a designated bike spot?
Liam: I can grab a tarp + wheel chocks from maintenance. Recommend storing the bike in Maintenance Bay B (out of walkways). Put the plant in Green Room by the kitchen — more sunlight.
Zoe: that's my partner 60a please keep the plant upright and away from drafts. Also battery should NOT be charged indoors unless supervised.
Priya: Plan: bike -> Bay B, plant -> Green Room (table by window). Battery kept with bike but not plugged in. Temporary badge PRCL-6001 expires 6pm. Please label both items with PRCL-6001 and "Elias".
Noah: Bike moved to Bay B, placed cardboard under tires, left photo at front desk (posted).
Liam: Plant staged in Green Room on the east table. Couch near kitchen reserved 4-6pm for visitor seating. Left sticky: "Elias - do not water".
Frontdesk Bot: Note: Locker B7 available for small parcel storage (code `8891`). Badge PRCL-6001 set to auto-expire at 18:00.
Priya: Awesome, thanks everyone. Closing thread after pickup. Huge appreciate it :raised_hands: 
Zoe: thank you!! tell Elias his iced tea is in the fridge 379
